Project Description:
IFC's guarantee will help Niom Communications Corp expand 4G and 5G mobile coverage in Philippines.
The investment will improve digital access for underserved households and small businesses.

The proposed minority shareholding to Nirastek Energy PLC will finance a gas-fired power plant in Tanzania. The project will improve the reliability of electricity supply. Land acquisition and biodiversity risks will be managed under IFC Performance Standards.

Vani Capital PLC will use IFC's risk management facility to finance micro, small and medium-sized enterprises (MSMEs) in South Africa, with a focus on rural and agricultural small businesses.
The facility will broaden access to finance in an underserved market.

IFC's A-loan will help Raskor Telecom Group expand 4G and 5G mobile coverage in Lao People's Democratic Republic. It will strengthen the country's digital infrastructure and lower the cost of connectivity.
IFC's currency hedging facility will help Kelamanir Works Corp expand its building materials production in Micronesia. It will replace imports with locally produced goods.
